feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 13 September 2026 7:22am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 13 September 2026 at 7:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Weak ridge of high pressure will cover the Irish Sea today, before Atlantic fronts approach tomorrow.


##Wind##

Variable 2 or 3, settling South or Southeast 3 or 4 this evening or at first tonight, then veering South or Southwest later in the night.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair, then mist and fog patches developing tonight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling poor or very poor in mist and fog patches later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or Southwest 3 or 4, increasing 4 or 5 later tomorrow morning, then 5 or 6 later in the day. Veering and decreasing West or Northwest 4 or 5 overnight into Tuesday.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building moderate later tomorrow, becoming slight or moderate overnight into Tuesday.


##Weather##

Mist and fog patches at first, with rain then developing at times. Becoming fair overnight into Tuesday.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor, and falling very poor in any fog patches at first.
